scope: Unified customer timeline only, not the complete customer platform
historicalFacts: OrderEvent allowlist with canonical creation; missing creation event falls back to explicit record-created wording
Successful existing Inquiry/Fitting/StaffTask audit actions only; current status is never synthesized into history
FinancialTransaction rows for payments/refunds/deposits/reversals; audit copies are not repeated
Active existing notes, explicitly current text/edited timestamp; deep-link to the original edit form
Current customer/branch/source relations used for access and attribution; no inferred contact matching
notAvailable: Exact physical arrival time from a fitting status snapshot
Former note text or archived/deleted note versions
Complete historical customer linkage/name/branch snapshots where source did not store them
Unrecorded historical transitions, external conversations, WA/TG messages
security: Every read checks active membership and user
Per-source operation rights, tenant and branch scope; seller own-task restriction preserved
No generic audit metadata, raw reasons, tokens, unknown status payloads, denied money or foreign entity links
dedupeAndPagination: Canonical business source; one creation record per entity; bounded 50-row keyset with stable timestamp/key ordering and filter/customer-bound cursor

tests: Chronological keyset pagination preserves all equal-time sources without duplicate creation/audit/conversion events
Legacy current statuses never become invented history; notes explicitly retain only current text; audit JSON secrets never escape DTO
Category/date/legacy order-type filters enforce inclusive UTC boundaries and reject malformed or mismatched cursor/filter input
Seller redaction uses each source permission, active branch scope and own-task access; no payment values or foreign tenant links
Deny overrides remove each source and implicit order links without removing accessible client notes; only payment grant exposes payments, never deposits
Read-only timeline leaves ledger, events, audit and notes unchanged and rechecks active membership
Desktop unified page offers permitted categories and keyset next-page links without duplicate equal-time events
Desktop category/inclusive-date filter shows ledger-only payment/refund/reversal; order link and Back retain exact filter
UI distinguishes saved fitting/task statuses from current state and labels missing-history fallback as record creation
Mobile seller HTML and streamed data exclude finance, foreign branch and other employee task; denied category fails closed without overflow
Existing notes are escaped as text and deep-link to the existing edit form, without a parallel comment store
Empty period, invalid date and foreign customer have explicit recoverable empty/error/not-found states
Repeated full document loads preserve Next history state and render timeline without reload loops
Early popstate guard still warns before Next replaces a dirty order form; cancel preserves text and accept navigates
